answer: Challenge tasks are cryptographically entangled with future unbiasable beacon pulses: a verifier derives each task from a drand quicknet round only after participants commit, so automated sybil swarms cannot precompute answers or farm a fixed challenge offline. The pulse makes challenges unpredictable, not identities unique; stake, rate limits, or scarce credentials must still bound identities. A trellis of commitments can bind responses to an atlas of rounds, while a forge-resistant transcript enables public verification.
